root_idea.summary: The root centers on what is behind, at the back, or at the end, in contrast with what is before or in front.
root_idea.development: From spatial backness and following come meanings of retreating, coming after, reaching an outcome, considering an affair's consequences, managing it with forethought, and referring to its latter part or surviving remnant. Several specialized usages preserve the same back/end orientation.

senses.definition: To manage, arrange, regulate, or dispose of an affair with forethought.
senses.usage_conditions: The construction concerns considering an affair's issues, consequences, or orderly execution; it may be used of divine governance and of deliberate human management.

senses.definition: To turn back, go away, retreat, or turn one's back.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of a person or group moving away or backward, in contrast with advancing or approaching.

senses.definition: To depart or pass into its latter stage; to decline or recede.
senses.usage_conditions: Used especially of night, day, a season, or another period or condition. Interpretations of the Quranic expression concerning night include its following the day and its retreating to depart.

senses.definition: To reflect on, examine, and seek to understand the meaning and consequences of something.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran it is used of considering the Quran or revealed speech deeply and repeatedly in order to attain understanding.

senses.definition: The latter part, aftermath, or time after something; departure into what follows.
senses.usage_conditions: Used as a temporal adverbial expression. In Quranic usage it can refer to what follows or to the latter parts of an act or period; it is related to the back or end of the thing.

senses.definition: The last remaining part, remnant, or root of a people or group.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran it denotes the surviving end or stock of a people, especially in expressions about cutting them off or extirpating them.

senses.definition: The back, rear, or hinder side of a person or thing.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran uses it for the back of a person and for the rear or back side of an object, in contrast with the front.

senses.definition: A person's turning back or retreating, especially in the construction of turning or putting one's back.
senses.usage_conditions: This is a conventional resultative use of the noun: turning the back denotes flight, retreat, or being routed rather than merely describing anatomy.

senses.definition: The latter or concluding part of something.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic temporal and ritual expressions it denotes the end or latter parts of prayers, prostration, or another period; it may also refer to what follows toward the west or setting.

senses.definition: One who manages, orders, or regulates affairs.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic feminine plural refers to entities charged with arranging or administering affairs; the singular citation form is shown here for the lexical item.

senses.definition: Turning away, retreating, or fleeing with one's back turned.
senses.usage_conditions: It is an active participle of أَدْبَرَ and may describe a person or group in the state of retreat or departure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To follow behind someone or something; to come after in place, time, or rank.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I verb of following or succeeding, including coming after another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an arrow, to pass beyond the target and fall behind it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used specifically of an arrow passing beyond the butt or target.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go away with something, carry it off, or cause it to pass away.
Of a people, to perish, go away, and not return.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the Form I resultative sense of disappearance or destruction, distinct from simply retreating.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To grow old or reach its later stage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported especially of night in an interpretation associated with a Quranic reading, but the cited reading is not the canonical QAC form at that location.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the wind, to blow from the west or hinder quarter, or to change and come from that direction.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The west is conceived as the direction behind or at the back.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be struck or affected by the westerly wind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An impersonal or passive Form I usage referring to the wind called الدَّبُور.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To write a writing, letter, or book.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare attribution to one authority; other lexical authorities reject it in favor of ذَبَرَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, camel, or similar animal, to develop galls or sores on the back.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sores are produced by a saddle or similar burden.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a slave or enslaved person free after the owner's death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The declaration makes emancipation depend on the owner's death; this legal usage is called tadbīr.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To transmit a tradition, narrative, or report received from another person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reported usage is attributed to authorities and is especially described as transmitting it after that person's death; it is disputed by authorities who read ذَبَرَ instead.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn away from a companion, avoid or shun him, and become hostile or at variance with him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reciprocal or relational sense extends to severing ties of kinship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a slit in the hinder part of a ewe's, goat's, or camel's ear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The slit leaves or produces a hanging strip turned toward the back.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To feign negligence or inattention toward a friend's need, as though turning away from him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative interpersonal extension of turning the back.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an affair or people's condition, to take a backward course or decline into a bad state.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sense is opposed to advancing or improving; it may describe the decline of good fortune.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a prayer, to end or reach its conclusion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative temporal use derived from the prayer's entering its latter part.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To die or pass away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of departing; it is not the ordinary Quranic retreat sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To place or make a person or thing behind another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of relative position, as opposed to placing something in front.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause a camel, horse, or similar animal to become galled or sore on the back; also, of the animal, to become so galled.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source distinguishes causative and intransitive applications of the back-sore construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To perform or describe an ear-slitting operation in which the hanging strip turns toward the back of the neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the Form IV terminology for the same specialized ear marking contrasted with إِقْبَالَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To recognize a person's paternal or maternal side from the other side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic use involving knowing the back or rear aspect of lineage in contrast with its front aspect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enter upon a period in which the westerly wind is blowing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized meteorological usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To travel on the day called دُبَار, Wednesday.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An archaic calendrical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become possessed of much property, wealth, or many camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized lexical usage unrelated to the ordinary retreat sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To know or recognize something only at the end, after it has passed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This resultative sense is distinct from deliberately examining something in order to understand it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn one's back on one another; hence to sever relations, avoid one another, speak behind one another's backs, or withhold mutual assistance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meanings are reciprocal extensions of refusing to face or support the other party.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn one's back toward something or orient one's back to it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: For example, to turn one's back toward the qiblah; it is the opposite of facing something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come behind someone and throw or shoot at him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A spatial pursuit construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To discover at the end of an affair what was not known at its beginning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A hindsight construction concerning the eventual outcome of an affair.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To appropriate something exclusively for oneself in preference to others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The figurative explanation is that the person turns his back on others and withdraws it from them.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place or quarter behind something; figuratively, to disregard speech or turn a deaf ear to it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The figurative idiom treats the speech as being placed behind the ear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative meaning related to departure and cessation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Constant or prolonged sleep.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An archaic figurative usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tract or patch of cultivated land, or the small irrigation channels between such tracts.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word may denote the plots themselves or the channels and rivulets serving them.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mountain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported usage associated with Abyssinian speech and accompanied by disagreement over the reading; it is not the ordinary Arabic branch of the root.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A swarm of bees, hornets, or similar stinging insects.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The name is associated with the insects' weapons being at their hinder parts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The young of locusts.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized collective noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Much property, wealth, or numerous camels beyond ordinary reckoning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective or noun may be used with singular, dual, or plural مال without changing form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tract or quarter of the western sky near sunset.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in an archaic astronomical or seasonal expression concerning the setting of the Pleiades.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A gall or sore on the back of a horse, camel, or similar animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sore is caused by a saddle or comparable burden; the term may also extend to a camel's callous breast projection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having galls or sores on the back, said of a horse, camel, or similar animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective describes the animal rather than the sore itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a fixed descriptive expression, ruined or perishing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The analysis of this expression is disputed: it may be a possessive epithet or an imitative pairing with another adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The backside, buttocks, rump, or anus; in animals, the hinder genital or anal region.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical meaning distinct from the general rear side; its exact scope varies by animal and context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The hinder part or rear corner of a house, chamber, or tent.
Emancipation of a slave made effective after the owner's death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A legal phrase corresponding to the Form II verb دَبَّرَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A turn of evil fortune, defeat, or the adverse issue of an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may denote the defeat of an adversary, one's own defeat, or the result in whose favor an affair has turned.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The direction or point toward which one turns one's back.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It is the opposite of قِبْلَةٌ and appears in idioms about lacking a clear way to proceed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Backward, late, or occurring at the end of the relevant time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It can describe a late answer or opinion, following behind, or performing prayer at the latest part of its time.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The Hyades, especially the star or asterism following the Pleiades.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An astronomical name explained through the star's following the Pleiades.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wednesday, or the night preceding Wednesday.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An ancient name, sometimes associated with the day's alleged ill fortune.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The latter part or end of an affair, in contrast with its beginning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions distinguishing the beginning of an affair from its conclusion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The west or westerly wind, conceived as coming from behind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The wind is associated with the direction of sunset and is traditionally contrasted with the easterly wind; it is also described as a harsh or unfavorable wind.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The part or action of twisting a thread, flax, or wool backward or away from the chest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It is contrasted with قَبِيلٌ, the forward-twisted part or action; the same contrast can describe distinguishing one side or lineage from another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An arrow that loses in a game of chance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized gambling term, opposed to the winning arrow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The upper or hinder part of a camel's ear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized anatomical sense contrasted with the forward part called قَبِيلٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who follows or comes last; the last remaining part of anything, including what is past.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This broader Classical usage includes the last person of a group, a past day such as yesterday, or the last item of an object; the Quranic remnant/root sense is listed separately under the Quranic form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An arrow that passes beyond the target and falls behind it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized active-participle description of an arrow's trajectory.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An arrow or person that loses or is overcome in the game of chance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may refer to a losing arrow, a repeatedly defeated player, or one who handles the arrows in the lottery game, according to differing explanations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The last arrow remaining in a quiver.
The end of a tract of sand.
A specialized hinder part: the rear part of a hoof or the back toe or striking appendage of a bird.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The exact anatomical referent varies by animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wrestling throw or maneuver involving a trick.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical usage in wrestling terminology.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A slit or hanging strip in the hinder part of a ewe's, goat's, or camel's ear, turned backward.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The ear marking and the animal bearing it are both described with this terminology; the forward counterpart is إِقْبَالَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who severs kinship ties, rejects what is said to him, or refuses admonition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A strongly figurative characterization of one who turns away from relations or counsel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An aged she-camel whose former goodness has declined.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative specialization of having gone into decline.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land on which rain has fallen only partially rather than generally.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reading and contrast with the corresponding forward form are noted as uncertain in the lexical discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A slave whose emancipation has been made effective after the owner's death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A legal passive participle of the Form II emancipation construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Struck or affected by the westerly wind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participle referring to a person or people affected by الدَّبُور.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wounded or galled in the back.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form can describe an animal or person bearing a back injury or sore.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Possessing much property, wealth, or many camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjective with a meaning unrelated to the passive sense of being affected or wounded.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Situated behind or at the rear of a place of abode.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as the opposite of مُقَابَلٌ, a place or neighbor situated in front.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having the hinder part of the ear slit; figuratively, being of noble or pure lineage through both parents.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lineage expression pairs مُقَابَلٌ and مُدَابَرٌ to refer to honorable descent from both sides.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who turns away from or shuns a companion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative active participle of the Form III reciprocal relation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person or arrow overcome in the game of chance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical explanations include a repeatedly defeated player and, in one account, one who turns or shuffles the arrows.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Noble or generous in both the earlier and later acquisition of honor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression represents honor as lying both behind and before the person.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Contains management and Quran-attested reflection/understanding branches.
The incomplete pointer is covered by the following lexical unit.
Contains temporal, interpersonal, prayer-ending, and death extensions.
Pointer back to the back-galling branch.
Additional landform specialization within the same lexical branch.
Infinitival relation to the back-sore meaning.
Contains the general back and conventional flight construction.
Contains both the Quran-attested remnant sense and the broader last-of-anything sense.
Additional bird anatomy within the specialized hinder-part branch.
Defines the noun as equivalent to the represented departure/decline branch.
The normalized public participle represents the Quranic plural lexical item.

cautions: The Lane discussion of the Quranic night expression includes alternate readings and interpretations; its bracketed historical citation notation has not been converted into an independently asserted modern location beyond the secure QAC occurrence for أَدْبَرَ at 74:33.

Some rare Classical branches are explicitly disputed or attributed to limited authorities, especially the Form I writing sense, the mountain sense of دَبْرٌ, the reported night reading, and certain specialized Form IV usages.
The Quranic participial group مُدَبِّرَات has been normalized to the singular citation form مُدَبِّرَةٌ; its Quranic occurrence remains the supplied feminine plural.
